title: What is an authorization hold?
summary: Explains authorization holds: temporary holds on funds not available for use, commonly placed by merchants to verify sufficient funds and secure deposits (lodging, fuel, rentals). Notes holds may not appear immediately in recent transactions, reduces available balance, paycheck deposit holds may be refunded, and release timing depends on merchant processing/settlement.
